assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: layered background for a premium Dutch interactive children's storybook, ages 4–8. Create one complete landscape 1536x1024 illustration, a cozy whimsical fairy-tale railway platform at golden hour in green rolling hills. Warm cinematic premium 3D storybook rendering, tactile wood and brass, soft rounded architecture, lush tiny flowers, delicate firefly sparkles. The platform is a broad flat open foreground terrace with clean space for separately animated characters. Railway tracks enter the lower foreground and curve away into the distance. At the rear side is a charming small station wall, a wooden bench and a little closed wooden cupboard with a distinct simple door, suitable as a clickable object. Peaceful green hills, soft trees and a warm pastel sky beyond. Keep the center and lower foreground visually calm. No train, no animals, no people, no characters, no lettering, no signs with words, no logo, no watermark. Full bleed landscape image, nothing framed.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent character cutout for an interactive premium children's storybook, ages 4–8. One lovable small green baby dragon, Dibbel, full body in a three-quarter front view, looking gently toward the viewer. Soft rounded 3D cinematic toy-like rendering, tactile fine velvety green scales, warm golden cream belly, two tiny rounded horns, small folded wings, expressive large warm eyes, friendly slightly hopeful smile. The dragon holds a single simple blank cream railway ticket in its two front paws; the ticket has an obvious jagged tear near its center but the two sides are still together, as if waiting for a sticker repair. Ticket has NO marks or letters. Stubby feet visible, cute modest body proportions, no sharp scary features. Centered isolated full body with margin above head and around wings and feet. Soft warm golden light and subtle dimensional shading that matches a fairy-tale woodland station. Transparent background with genuine alpha, no backdrop, no floor or cast rectangular shadow, no text, no logo, no watermark. Square 1024x1024.

Charming, luxurious and child-friendly. No character or driver. No railway tracks, no floor, no scenery, no background, NO steam or smoke; those will be animated separately. Genuine transparent alpha background. No letters, numbers, logo or watermark. Landscape 1536x1024.
